label: thm:stable
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:stable}
A normed space $X$ has metric stable type $p\in[1,2)$ if and only if $X$ has stable type $p$.
head: environment

title: Corollary
body_md: A normed space $X$ is K-convex if and only if $X$ has metric stable type $1$.

title: Lemma
body_md: Fix $\pmb{\alpha}\in(0,1)^n$ and let $\{X_t^{\pmb{\alpha}}\}_{t\geq0}$ be a Markov process on $\{-1,1\}^n$ with transition kernels $\{p_t^{\pmb{\alpha}}\}_{t\geq0}$. Then, $\{X_t^{\pmb{\alpha}}\}_{t\geq0}$ is stationary and reversible with respect to $\mu_{\pmb{\alpha}}$.

label: lem:ole
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem:ole}
If $d<n$, there exists a continuous map $h_d:\mathbb{S}^d\to \mathscr{C}_d^n$ with $h_d(-x)=-h_d(x)$,   $\forall \ x\in\mathbb{S}^d$.
head: environment

label: lem:ole2
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{lem:ole2}
If $n,d\in\mathbb{N}$ with $d<n$,  then for every continuous function $F:\mathscr{C}_d^n\to \mathbb{R}^d$ there exists a point $z\in\mathscr{C}_d^n$ such that F(z)=F(-z).
